title: Jobs

empty.queue: No jobs yet — run analysis on a project.
empty.logsNoProject: Open or run a project to see its analysis logs.
empty.logsNoTelemetry: No telemetry yet — it appears once a run reads its first scene.

tooltip.scaleRelative: Each bar fills 100% — shows composition only
tooltip.scaleAbsolute: Bars scaled to the largest project — shows actual size

footer: History is universal — every project's runs, wherever you are. Pause is safe (resumes where it left off). Cost / memory / provider are machine-local.

logs.title: Clear analysis logs?
logs.message:
Deletes this project’s telemetry logs.

Diagnostics only — regenerated on the next run. Nothing else is affected.

history.title: Clear run history?
history.message:
Removes past-run records and their revert snapshots.

Your current analysis stays intact — you just lose the ability to revert to earlier versions.

chat.title: Delete chat sessions?
chat.message:
Deletes this project’s chat history from your machine.

This can’t be undone.

tasks.title: Clear the task inbox?
tasks.message:
Deletes this project’s background-task inbox — including any completed edits you haven’t applied yet.

This can’t be undone.

backups.title: Delete reset backups?
backups.message:
Removes the full “.nvs.bak-…” copies saved before each Reset analysis.

Safe — they’re only recovery snapshots; your current project and analysis are untouched. This can’t be undone.
